observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black console with a black stripe across the top, placed on a wooden cabinet. The console has a small logo on the top right corner, resembling the PlayStation logo.
Photo 1 shows the same console on the same cabinet, with a TV above it displaying a soccer game. The console is connected to the TV via cables. A round wall clock is visible on the cabinet.
The console appears to be the original PlayStation 5 model, with a matte white finish and a black side panel.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos, but the console is not shown from all angles or in detail.
The seller claims it is 'Barely Used'.

claims.evidence: The console appears clean and undamaged in the photos, but there is no close-up of the console's surface or ports to verify wear. The 'barely used' claim cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number on the back of the console, and a verification of the serial number via PlayStation's official website.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially blacklisted or stolen

risks.risk: Console may be missing accessories (e.g., controller, HDMI cable, power adapter)
risks.proof: Photos of all included accessories laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the serial number.
Video of the console powering on and running a game or menu.
Photos of all included accessories (controller, HDMI cable, power adapter, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
